flag_probes.expected: --help / --longhelp / --advanced --longhelp / --full-help are core-program flags, observed on the Linux build of the same 3.0.23 release; expected present on Windows [VERIFY-blocked-on-hardware]
flag_probes.shell_quoting: Windows users have to use the --option-name="value" syntax instead of the --option-name value syntax (public doc, see expected_differences #2)

expected_differences.expected: %appdata%\vlc\vlcrc, expanded per Windows generation (e.g. C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Roaming\vlc\vlcrc on Vista/7/8/10)
Quoted form --option-name="value" required instead of --option-name value
expected_differences.source: https://wiki.videolan.org/Documentation:Command_line/ (HTTP 200, accessed 2026-10-19; note 'Windows users have to use the --option-name="value" syntax')

expected_differences.expected: Device-bearing MRLs differ: e.g. dvd:// takes a block-device path on GNU/Linux but a drive letter with / and :/ on Windows (vlc dvd:///D:/)

VLC options are module-scoped (observed on Linux: 1476/1476 records live under 187 module sections, only 442 under 'core program'). The Windows build ships Windows-only modules, whose option families are therefore expected Windows-only additions to this inventory: dshow (DirectShow capture), mmdevice (WASAPI audio output), directx_aout (DirectSound), waveout, direct3d / glwin32 / wingdi (video outputs). Option NAMES under those modules are NOT enumerated here — capture on hardware.
expected_differences.source: module pages verified live 2026-10-19: https://wiki.videolan.org/Documentation:Modules/dshow/ , /mmdevice/ , /direct3d/ (HTTP 200 each); directx_aout/waveout/glwin32/wingdi per docs/inventory/modules-windows.json (0.B2, same access date)

expected_differences.expected: The Linux inventory in options-linux.json lacks all --qt-* options because the pinned headless install excluded vlc-plugin-qt (scope_notes there). A default Windows install includes the Qt interface, so a large qt module option family is expected present in the Windows dump [VERIFY count on hardware].
expected_differences.source: scope limitation recorded in docs/inventory/options-linux.json scope_notes (our own observed install set, dump 02/05); qt module presence on Windows to be confirmed by the hardware --list dump (hardware-template.md §3)

expected_differences.expected: The 'core program (core)' section (442 options on Linux across Audio/Video/Subpictures/Decoders/Input/Stream output/Miscellaneous/Playlist/Hot keys) is expected substantially invariant across platforms, since it comes from the same core binary — differences expected mainly in platform device/output module sections. Hypothesis from the Linux observation; needs the hardware dump to confirm [VERIFY].
